newsitem.title: USA: U.S.JET FUEL DIFFS EASE MODESTLY IN QUIET TRADE.
newsitem.headline: U.S.JET FUEL DIFFS EASE MODESTLY IN QUIET TRADE.

text.p: U.S. jet fuel differentials showed little movement Monday, with few players willing to enter the market.
"I don't think there's much of anything going on today," one player said.
On the NYMEX, September heating oil futures firmed 0.07 cent to settle at 54.36 cents a gallon.
U.S. Gulf prompt 54-grade jet fuel was offered at 0.65 cent over the September futures Monday afternoon, though buyers sat staunchly at 0.55 cent under the futures.
Gulf prompt 55-grade low sulphur material was offered at 0.85 cent over the futures, holding a 0.20-cent premium to regular grade.
